name: Review morning dollar funding with Seiche and optional Slack or Telegram updates

parameters.content:
## 01 · Try the research task
Import into your n8n instance and select **Execute workflow**. Public evidence requires no API key, account or AI model.

[Try the browser demo](https://liquilens.in/start/?task=funding)

Edit **Task settings** for the bank slug, position size or snapshot-age limit where applicable. For another bank, check `banking_specialisation_coverage` first.

The workflow imports **inactive**. The schedule is weekdays at 08:00 **UTC**; change the workflow timezone and cron before publishing.

## 02 · Keep the source evidence
Open **Keep evidence and prepare update**. `evidence` preserves the complete source response; `message_text` is a short, deterministic summary.

Generation, retrieval and observation dates mean different things. Missing data stays missing. Old snapshots suppress current-looking summaries; transport/tool errors stop execution.

Funding context is not a bank rating. An NPA reduction is not necessarily a cash recovery. BTC costs use published depth bands and exclude fees.

[Setup and interpretation](https://beepboop2025.github.io/financial-evidence-skills/automations/)

## 03 · Optional delivery
Both message nodes are **disabled** on import.

To receive updates, choose one node, attach your own Slack or Telegram credential, enter your channel/chat ID and enable it. Test with your own destination.

Keep unused delivery nodes disabled. Activate the workflow only after reviewing its schedule.

Your n8n execution retention settings determine how long the full evidence is kept. No trading or credit decision is automated.
